items.title: Negotiating a refresher grant: how much does the exit outcome matter?
items.description: Dana's ask was a refresher equity grant, vesting over 4 years, on top of her $150,000 base and $15,000 target bonus. But private-company equity is only worth what it's worth at an eventual exit — the current $14/share 409A value could turn out to be pessimistic or optimistic by the time shares vest. Drag the refresher grant size and the eventual exit-value multiple (relative to today's $14 409A price) to see what Dana's total comp would actually turn out to be next year. The market P50 for her role is $175,000, and P75 is $205,000, for reference.
items.compute: const annualTranche = params.refresherShares / 4; const perShareValue = 14 * params.exitMultiple; const equityValue = annualTranche * perShareValue; const totalComp = 150000 + 15000 + equityValue; return { totalComp };
